source_name: ČNB — Proticyklická kapitálová rezerva: otázky a odpovědi / CCyB methodology note
why_relevant: Explains the decision mechanics that determine timing: quarterly rate-setting obligation, increases normally announced ~1 year ahead, decreases effective without delay. Essential for converting a decision into a forward calendar of bank obligations. The companion methodology PDF documents the buffer guide and ESRB-recommendation inputs.

source_name: ČNB — Doporučení k řízení rizik spojených s poskytováním spotřebitelských úvěrů zajištěných obytnou nemovitostí
why_relevant: The soft-law 'Doporučení' (comply-or-explain recommendation) that supplements the binding limits — e.g. LTV/DTI expectations for investment-purpose mortgages. Non-compliance can trigger add-on capital requirements, so it functions as a dated supervisory expectation.

source_name: ČNB — Zpráva o výkonu dohledu za rok 2025 (current edition announcement)
why_relevant: The 'aktuality' announcement page for each edition is the earliest dated signal that a new supervisory report exists, and summarises headline supervisory conclusions before the PDF is parsed.

source_name: ČNB legislativa PDF gallery (export/sites/cnb/.../zakony/) — regulator-hosted act PDFs
why_relevant: ČNB hosts its own working consolidated PDFs of key acts (e.g. zákon o bankách 21/1992 Sb.). Useful as a regulator-endorsed snapshot and as a stable file-level artifact when the CMS reorganises; also the file naming reveals the full act inventory.

source_name: Portál občana / portal.gov.cz – service description for payment-institution reporting obligation
why_relevant: State service catalogue entry restating the payment-institution reporting duty, its legal basis and submission timing in structured form — a useful cross-check and an ID-stable anchor (S50469) for the obligation.

source_name: ÚOOÚ – Protokoly o kontrole / poskytnuté informace (inspection protocols released under FOI)
why_relevant: Full-text inspection protocols (čj. UOOU-xxxxx) released via the Act 106/1999 FOI channel expose the actual control questions, findings and remedies applied to regulated entities — far richer than press summaries.

source_name: ÚOOÚ – Výroční zpráva (annual report)
why_relevant: Annual statutory report gives enforcement volumes (inspections opened/closed, administrative proceedings, fines) and signals the next year's control plan priorities — a leading indicator of where bank inspections go next.

source_name: Ministerstvo financí – finanční gramotnost portal: Dohled nad ochranou spotřebitele
why_relevant: Government-authored description of the split of consumer-protection supervision between ČNB, ČOI, finanční arbitr and others — useful to attribute a given deadline to the correct publisher.

source_name: NÚKIB – Aktuality: publication of the new Cybersecurity Act (zák. č. 264/2025 Sb.)
why_relevant: Authoritative announcement of the NIS2 transposition act effective 1 Nov 2025 — the anchor document for every downstream registration and implementation deadline for financial entities.

source_name: Vláda ČR — ODok system description and Legislativní pravidla vlády
why_relevant: Explains the document-circulation system and the formal rules that govern stages and comment-period durations — needed to interpret VeKLEP stage codes and to compute realistic consultation deadlines.

source_name: ÚOHS – Výroční zpráva (annual report, enforcement statistics)
why_relevant: Annual enforcement totals and priority setting for the competition authority, including where payment/financial markets sit in its agenda.

source_name: MF ČR — Zpráva o vývoji finančního trhu (annual financial market report)
why_relevant: Annual MF report includes a dedicated chapter on national and EU legislative activity in the financial market — an authoritative retrospective index of what changed and what is pending; useful for backfilling a legislative timeline.

source_name: EPC – List of Countries in the SEPA Schemes (EPC409-09)
why_relevant: Defines the geographic scope of scheme applicability (CZ included as non-euro SEPA country) — needed to reason correctly about which EPC obligations and which timelines apply to Czech PSPs.

source_name: AKAT ČR — industry association coverage of ČNB supervisory reports
why_relevant: Industry association republishing and framing ČNB supervisory reports — useful as an independent redundancy channel and, more importantly, as a signal of which parts of a supervisory report the regulated industry considers material.

source_name: Schönherr (Praha) — monthly 'Novinky z české a evropské regulace finančních institucí' on epravo.cz
why_relevant: Verified monthly law-firm series (authored by Schönherr's Prague office, published via epravo.cz) covering Czech AND EU financial-institution regulation with concrete dates — e.g. the January 2026 edition names 30 March 2026 for Eurosystem DLT collateral and 2026 Listing Act steps. Longest-running deadline-bearing adviser series found in this cell; runs back to at least 2021.

entity_name: Právní prostor / Czech law-firm legislative commentary
source_name: Pravniprostor.cz / finreg.cz – Czech legal commentary tracking ČNB supervisory and licensing activity
why_relevant: Czech financial-regulation law blogs summarise ČNB supervisory statistics (inspection counts, DORA first inspections, crypto-licence application volumes) and decode enforcement decisions faster than the primary register. Useful as an interpretation layer and as an early pointer to decisions worth pulling from ABOK.

source_name: ČSOB – Manuál pro obchodníky přijímající platby kartou (acquirer merchant manual)
why_relevant: Czech acquirer's merchant manual is where scheme mandates get translated into concrete local obligations and deadlines for CZ merchants and terminal estates — a practical proxy for how Visa/MC rules land in the CZ market. Comparable manuals exist at other CZ acquirers.

source_name: ECB / ERPB – Status updates on SCT Inst scheme, QR-code standardisation and VoP
why_relevant: ERPB meeting documents give scheme-adoption statistics and forward timetables (including non-euro-area readiness) that EPC pages state only in prose; useful for dating obligations and gauging CZ readiness.

source_name: Fio banka / Seznam Zprávy — market press reporting on ČNB macroprudential decisions
why_relevant: Czech financial press and bank research desks summarise Bank Board financial-stability decisions within hours and add market interpretation; useful for gauging expected impact and for catching decisions if the ČNB feed is missed.

source_name: Lupa.cz – ICT/regulatory trade press coverage of NIS2 and Portál NÚKIB
why_relevant: Reveals indirectly how the NIS2 registration machinery actually behaves in practice (portal defects, low compliance rates) — friction signals that formal regulator pages do not disclose.

source_name: Bank career pages (e.g. Partners banka – Specialista Compliance)
why_relevant: First-party bank job ads state which regulatory monitoring duties (AML, GDPR, regulatory watch) a specific institution is staffing — institution-attributable evidence that aggregators lose. Extendable to ČSOB, KB, ČS, Air Bank, Raiffeisenbank, Fio, MONETA career portals.

source_name: Banking Innovation Forum & Expo (Cubex Centrum Praha)
why_relevant: Long-running CZ banking innovation event bringing together bank leaders, risk specialists and payment innovation vendors; venue and organiser pages list agendas that surface regulatory-driven themes early.

source_name: Citfin – Oznámení o změně Všeobecných obchodních podmínek (news-style change notices)
why_relevant: Example of a smaller CZ payment institution publishing 'Oznámení o změně VOP' as a dated news item — the canonical phrasing to fingerprint across the whole PSP population when building an automated notice detector.

source_name: COMPLIANCE SUMMIT (Akademie C. H. Beck)
why_relevant: Annual CZ compliance conference (2nd edition 12 March 2026) covering AML, corporate criminal liability, AI & cybersecurity. Agenda shows which compliance obligations legal practitioners expect to dominate the coming year; organiser is a legal publisher close to regulators.

source_name: Finmag.cz – reporting on NIS2 registration shortfalls and NÚKIB remediation guidance
why_relevant: Financial-sector-facing press that carries NÚKIB statements on missed registration deadlines and sanction exposure — useful early-warning of enforcement posture.

entity_name: gdpr.cz / compliance-portal reporting on FAÚ annual report fines
source_name: gdpr.cz / compliance-portal reporting on FAÚ annual report fines
why_relevant: Secondary summaries that extract the enforcement/fine statistics out of FAÚ annual reports shortly after publication. Useful as a cross-check and as a discovery signal that a new výroční zpráva has landed; the underlying FAÚ PDF remains authoritative.

source_name: Glatzová & Co. — Právní akademie: Nařízení DORA
why_relevant: Independent Prague firm running a structured 'legal academy' explainer format on DORA — a readiness/training artefact that typically lays out obligations against dates in Czech, i.e. exactly the practical-trigger-date material this cell targets.

source_name: International law-firm PSD3/PSR trackers (Norton Rose Fulbright, Morrison Foerster, Freshfields, HSF Kramer, Worldline)
why_relevant: PSD3/PSR is still pre-publication; these trackers are currently the most granular public reconstruction of the trilogue outcome, scope and the entry-into-force + 18/21-month application arithmetic that will determine the CZ deadline. Replace with EUR-Lex CS text the moment the OJ publication lands.

source_name: PIERSTONE — DORA: Povinnosti a implementace (client briefing PDF)
why_relevant: Prague technology-law boutique; a downloadable cs-language DORA obligations-and-implementation briefing — a concrete example of the deadline-tracker artefact this cell exists to find, and a marker that Pierstone publishes such PDFs regularly.

source_name: PixelBrothers – blog on ČSOB legacy API endpoint shutdown (integrator commentary)
why_relevant: Integrator-side commentary that surfaces and dates bank API deprecations faster and more legibly than the bank portals themselves; useful as a tripwire that a bank has published a deadline, then verify against the bank source.

source_name: PwC Legal EU RegCORE — Client Alerts (payments framework)
why_relevant: PwC Legal's EU RegCORE issues dated PDF client alerts on PSD3/PSR and the EU payments framework; EU-level but directly consumed by Czech payment institutions and often the earliest plain statement of trigger dates. Cross-border, not CZ-authored — use as a timeline benchmark against CZ-firm alerts.

source_name: Sonet blog – CARDFORUM conference reports (vendor post-event coverage)
why_relevant: CZ payments vendor publishing write-ups of CARDFORUM editions in CS and EN. Where the conference itself publishes no online agenda, vendor recaps are the only accessible record of which regulatory/technical topics were discussed.
